spell.sarps_spells.updraft.guide: Quickly launch yourself forward with strong winds, harmless to creatures.
spell.sarps_spells.levitate.guide: Cast to curse a targeted creature with levitation, making them fall a great distance when the effect ends.
spell.sarps_spells.emerging_tentacles.gu: Make tentacles of sculk come out of the ground, damaging anyone below them.
spell.sarps_spells.sunlight_lance.guide: Hold to charge a lance made of sunlight. Release to throw it, dealing high damage to a an area.
spell.sarps_spells.holy_dagger_rain.guid: Summon holy daggers around the target, dealing continuous damage to an area.
spell.sarps_spells.lions_claw.guide: Somersault forwards, striking foes with armament.
ui.sarps_spells.aow: This spell is only castable when imbued to an item.
